name: seal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
L='/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-27/new-discoveries-batch2/new-twenty-2026-10-31/list-color-threshold-primary-qualification-claude-r1'
import os,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
EXCL={'MANIFEST.json','seal_manifest.receipt.json','seal_manifest.output.txt'}
rows=[]
for r,d,f in os.walk(L):
    d.sort()
    for x in sorted(f):
        p=os.path.join(r,x); rel=os.path.relpath(p,L)
        if rel in EXCL: continue
        b=open(p,'rb').read()
        rows.append({"path":rel,"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
m={"target":353552,"count":len(rows),"terminal_noncircular_self_exclusions":sorted(EXCL),"note":"Excluded files are this manifest and the receipt and output of the runner invocation that writes it; they cannot contain their own hashes. No later writes to frozen inputs.","files":rows}
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',L+'/write_lane.py','MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(m,indent=0)+"\n",text=True,capture_output=True)
print('writer',z.returncode,z.stderr)
print('files sealed',len(rows))
for k in ['PROOF.md','REVIEW.md','OBSTRUCTION-K3L.md','review.json','source-map.json','frozen-after.json','guard-ledger.jsonl','search-charges.jsonl','search-budget.json']:
    print(k,[ (x['bytes'],x['sha256'][:16]) for x in rows if x['path']==k])
print('receipts',sum(1 for x in rows if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')))
print('budget',open(L+'/search-budget.json').read().replace('\n',' '))
sys.exit(z.returncode)
